_meta.description: Documented infrastructure bugs discovered during 2026-05 audit. Each silently inflated in-sample backtest results.

bugs.name: Look-ahead bias in feature scaler
bugs.description: StandardScaler.fit_transform() called on first invocation regardless of whether data was training or inference. Caller passing combined train+test dataframe silently fitted scaler on future data.
bugs.detection_method: Multi-market walk-forward showed systematic OOS Sharpe drop vs IS
bugs.fix: Added explicit fit_scaler: bool parameter; raises RuntimeError if normalize=True without loaded scaler

bugs.name: Hardcoded current_drawdown=0.0 disables killswitch
bugs.description: Position sizer received current_drawdown=0.0 hardcoded with `# TODO` comment. Risk killswitch logic never triggered regardless of actual portfolio performance.
bugs.detection_method: Code grep for TODO/FIXME during audit
bugs.fix: Added DecisionLogger.get_current_drawdown() that walks closed-trade log, compounds realized P&L, returns peak-to-trough drawdown

bugs.name: Inverted dispersion-to-position-size formula in tests
bugs.description: Source code in core/rolling_dispersion.py was CORRECT (agreement → high multiplier). Tests asserted opposite. Earlier audit had been about to invert SOURCE to match wrong tests.
bugs.detection_method: Read source docstring vs tests during this revision
bugs.fix: Corrected tests to match documented and correct source behavior

bugs.name: Three inconsistent Sharpe annualization factors
bugs.description: Three different annualization factors in use simultaneously. First two arithmetically identical (24192) but inconsistent in meaning. Third different value. None correct for 24/7 crypto.
bugs.fix: Single canonical bars_per_year(timeframe, asset_class) in core/metrics_calculator.py; vectorbt freq parameter unified

bugs.name: Data file naming mismatch BTC_USDT vs BTCUSDT
bugs.description: Loader expected canonical naming with underscore between asset and quote. DVC tracked Binance-native naming without underscore. 5 test cases silently failing with FileNotFoundError for months.
bugs.fix: Loader now accepts both naming conventions

net_effect.conclusion: Original README numbers were artifacts of bugs above, not real edge.
